notes: Basri, Devoted Paladin, printed: '[-1]: Whenever a creature attacks this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.' Each attacking creature triggers it separately (CR 508.3a, 603.2c), so two attackers put TWO triggers on the stack, which their controller orders (first-legal). Here the two creatures attack, the triggers wait, ONE resolves (the resolve op) and then seat 1 is put to 0 life, so the game ends before the other resolves: exactly one attacker has a counter (the Wolf, whose trigger the first-legal order resolves first) and the Bear has none. One trigger for both attackers would have put a counter on both.
